content.text:
I fixed it: switching to the "Đã xong" tab no longer says the list is empty when you still have todos. I sized it as **Small** (one bug in one file), so there's no committed plan.

**Cause:** the empty-list message ("Chưa có việc nào. Nếu có file sao lưu, hãy bấm Nhập từ file") was decided by the current tab instead of the whole list (`app/app.js:55`). So any tab with nothing to show told the customer they had no todos and pointed them at import.

**Fix:** the message now shows only when the whole list has no todos, and still not when the saved list couldn't be read. This is how it worked before commit `16d2846`.

**Tests:** I added two tests to `tests/app.test.js`, plus two small helpers in the test setup to switch tabs and to see whether the message is shown:
- **Tab with nothing to show:** 4 open todos, open "Đã xong", and the message must stay hidden. I ran it before the fix and it failed for the right reason: the message was shown.
- **No todos at all:** the message must still show on all three tabs. This keeps the fix from hiding it when the list really is empty.

```
ℹ tests 44
ℹ pass 44
ℹ fail 0
== lint: node --check app/*.js tests/*.js
== check: OK
```

Nothing is committed. Since a person is here, the usual order is to commit the test first, then the fix.

**Still open:**
- **The count line is also wrong (ticket T-013):** it counts open todos on the current tab only. On "Đã xong" it says "0 việc chưa xong" even when 4 aren't done. It was broken in the same commit. It's a separate ticket, so I left it alone.
- **A tab with nothing to show is now blank:** an empty "Đã xong" tab shows no message at all. Our UX rule says every list must define what it shows when empty (`policy-ux@2#U3`), so it probably needs its own short line, such as "Chưa có việc nào đã xong." The wording is a person's call.
